list.title: Bank accounts
list.intro: The company payer accounts used for transfer files, and the requests to add, replace or close an account, which take effect only once approved under the DOA. Account numbers show their last 4 digits only.
list.forbiddenHint: This page is for finance, procurement and auditors. If you need it, ask your organization administrator to add the role.
list.moduleOff: Your organization has not switched on the payments module. An organization administrator can switch it on in the administration pages.

payers.name: Account name
payers.empty: The company has no payer account yet
payers.emptyHint: Propose a company account with the bank's proof. Payment runs can use it once it is approved.
payers.neutralTemplate: {code} neutral test template, not a bank format

emptyHint.open: Drafts and requests waiting for approval show here. When a supplier asks to change its account, finance proposes it with the account change button.
emptyHint.all: Every request finance makes to add, replace or close an account shows here.

new.title: Propose a bank account change
new.intro: The new account does not take effect until the DOA approver approves it with a PIN. Until then nothing is paid into it.
new.forbiddenTitle: You cannot propose an account change
new.forbiddenHint: Adding, replacing or closing a bank account is proposed by finance. If a supplier asks to change its account, pass it to finance.

form.whatTitle: What do you want to change

kindHint.ADD: Add an account for a supplier that has none, or add a company payer account
kindHint.REPLACE: Replace the account in use with a new one. The old account stops when approved.
kindHint.CLOSE: Stop using an account without a new one

form.ownerSupplierHint: The account payment runs transfer to
form.ownerCompanyHint: A payer account used for transfer files
form.supplierHint: Search the supplier register by code or name
form.supplierSearch: Type a supplier code or name
form.supplierNone: No such supplier in the register
form.noCurrentAccount: This supplier has no account in effect yet
form.noTargets: The company has no account in effect
form.openChange: This account already has an unfinished request. Open that request to edit or cancel it first.
form.accountNoHint: 10 to 12 digits as in the passbook. Dashes and spaces are fine; only the digits are kept.
form.proofHint: A letter from the supplier or the bank, or a passbook page, as a PDF or a photo (JPG, PNG, HEIC). At least 1 file before sending for approval.
form.proofHintClose: Attach the closing letter if you have one. It is optional for closing an account.
form.callTitleRequired: Confirmation call (required to replace a supplier account)
form.callHint: Call the supplier at the phone number in the supplier register, not a number in the attached letter, then note who you spoke to and what the supplier confirmed.
form.noRegisterPhone: The supplier register has no phone number. Ask procurement to add one on the supplier page before calling.
form.callNoteHint: For example: called the register number, spoke to Somchai in accounts, who confirmed the change in the letter. Never write an account number.
form.callNoteShort: Write a call note of at least 3 characters
form.callTick: I called the phone number in the supplier register and the supplier confirmed this change
form.callTickError: Tick that you called the number in the supplier register before saving the call
form.reasonHint: The approver reads this. Never write an account number.
form.sendHint: Once sent, the request goes to the DOA approver, who confirms with a PIN every time. The proposer cannot approve their own request.

errors.pickSupplier: Choose a supplier from the register
errors.supplierHasAccount: This supplier already has an account in use. Choose replace instead of add.
errors.supplierHasNoAccount: This supplier has no account in effect yet. Choose add.
errors.pickTarget: Choose the company account to replace or close
errors.changeOpen: This account already has an open request. Open that request instead of proposing a new one.
errors.accountNo: Enter an account number of 10 to 12 digits
errors.accountName: Enter the account name as in the passbook

draft.title: Edit and send the request
draft.hint: This draft has not reached the approver. Correct it, attach the proof and record the call, then send it for approval.
draft.accountNoKeep: Current number {masked}. Leave blank to keep it.
draft.nothing: Nothing has changed yet. Edit a field before saving.
draft.callAgainHint: Changing the bank, account number or account name needs a new confirmation call and call note.
draft.checkCall: Confirmation call to the register number recorded

cancel.title: Cancel this request
cancel.hint: The request closes and no account changes. If it is waiting for approval, the approver's task closes too. This cannot be undone.
cancel.reasonHint: Everyone who opens this request sees the reason. Never write an account number.
cancel.reasonShort: Give a reason of at least 3 characters

decide.title: Decide this request
decide.stepUpHint: Bank account changes need your 6-digit PIN every time, to approve, return or reject, and cannot be decided from a LINE chat button.

confirmText.ADD: Approve {label}. The new account takes effect at once and the next payment run transfers to it. The decision cannot be changed later.
confirmText.REPLACE: Approve {label}. The old account stops and the new one takes effect at once; the next payment run transfers to the new account. The decision cannot be changed later.
confirmText.CLOSE: Approve {label}. The account closes at once and can no longer be paid from or into. The decision cannot be changed later.

decide.returnHint: The request goes back to draft for the proposer to fix and send again. No account changes.
decide.rejectHint: The request closes and no account changes. A change needs a new proposal.
decide.reasonHint: The proposer reads this. Say clearly what to fix or why it is rejected. Never write an account number.
decide.reasonError: Give a reason of at least 3 characters so the proposer knows what to fix

reveal.logged: This view of the full number was recorded with your name and the time

card.title: Payment account
card.name: Account name
card.maskedNote: Account numbers show their last 4 digits only. Changing the account needs a proposal approved under the DOA.
card.none: This supplier has no payment account in effect
card.noneHint: Payment runs cannot pay a supplier without an account. Finance proposes one with the supplier's letter.

detail.title: {kind}: {owner}
detail.forbiddenHint: Account change requests open for finance, procurement, auditors and the request's approvers only.

notice.saved: Draft saved. Check it, then send it for approval below.
notice.sent: Sent for approval. The request is with the DOA approver.
notice.incomplete: Draft saved, but some steps are not done yet. Continue below.

detail.returnedHint: The approver returned this request. See the reason in the history, fix it and send it again under the same number.
detail.sharedAccount: The proposed account is the account in use of another supplier with a different tax ID. Check with the supplier before sending or approving.
detail.contactChanged: The supplier's e-mail or phone in the register changed recently. Check with the supplier through the old channel before approving.
detail.applied: The new account has been in effect since {time}
detail.name: Account name
detail.maskedNote: Account numbers show their last 4 digits only
detail.wholeOld: Full number of the old account
detail.wholeNew: Full number of the new account
detail.proofsHidden: The proof shows the full account number, so only finance and the request's approvers can open it.
detail.stepUpValue: The approver confirms with a PIN every time

code.NO_ANSWER: No answer from the system yet. Check your connection and press again; the action runs only once.
code.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and try once more.
code.FORBIDDEN: You may not do this. Requests are proposed and edited by their finance proposer; full numbers are for finance and the approver.
code.NOT_FOUND: This request or account was not found. It may have been removed or belong to another organization.
code.MODULE_DISABLED: Your organization has not switched on the payments module. An organization administrator can switch it on in the administration pages.
code.CONFLICT_VERSION: This request was just changed elsewhere. Reload the page and try again.
code.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This was already sent with other details. Reload the page and try again.
code.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: The request's status has changed, so this cannot be done now. Reload the page to see its latest status.
code.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: Your DOA has no rule for bank account changes yet. Ask the organization administrator to add one before sending.
code.DOA_AMBIGUOUS: More than one DOA rule for bank account changes matches. Ask the organization administrator to fix the DOA before sending.
code.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: No one holds the approver position the DOA names. Ask the organization administrator to assign it before sending.
code.NO_HIGHER_AUTHORITY: The DOA approver is the proposer and there is no higher authority. Ask another finance member to propose it.
code.RATE_LIMITED: Too many actions in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
code.OTHER: This did not go through. Try again; if it still fails, contact your system administrator.

reason.REQUIRED: This is required. Fill it in before saving.
reason.OWNER: A supplier account needs its supplier, and the account type applies to company accounts only.
reason.TARGET: Replacing or closing needs the account in use; adding does not.
reason.CLOSE_HAS_ACCOUNT: Closing an account has no new account. Remove the new account details.
reason.CHANGE_OPEN: This supplier or account already has an unfinished request. Open that request to edit or cancel it first.
reason.ACCOUNT_EXISTS: This supplier already has an account in use. Choose replace instead of add.
reason.TARGET_NOT_FOUND: The chosen account does not belong to this owner. Choose again.
reason.TARGET_NOT_ACTIVE: The account to replace or close is no longer in use. Reload the page and choose the account in use.
reason.NOTE_HAS_ACCOUNT_NO: This text contains an account number. Remove it; only phone numbers and a description are allowed.
reason.NOTHING: Nothing has changed yet. Edit a field before saving.
reason.FILE: This file cannot be used. Upload the file yourself, then attach it again.
reason.TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Proof must be a PDF or a photo (JPG, PNG, HEIC).
reason.TOO_MANY: A request takes at most 10 proof files. Remove one you do not need first.
reason.PROOF_REQUIRED: There is no proof yet. Attach the supplier's letter or a passbook page before sending for approval.
reason.CALL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Replacing a supplier account needs a recorded confirmation call to the register number before sending for approval.
reason.NO_DEPARTMENT: Your organization has no departments yet. Ask the organization administrator to set them up before sending.
reason.ACCOUNT_NO_FORMAT: The account number must be digits; dashes and spaces are fine but no letters.
reason.ACCOUNT_NO_LENGTH: The account number must have 10 to 12 digits. Check it against the passbook.
reason.BANK_CODE_UNKNOWN: This bank is not known. Choose a bank from the list.
reason.ACCOUNT_NAME_FORMAT: The account name has characters that cannot be used. Type the name again as in the passbook.
reason.REASON_SHORT: Give a reason of at least 3 characters
reason.NOTE_SHORT: Write a call note of at least 3 characters
reason.NOTE_LONG: A call note can be at most 500 characters
reason.OTHER: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.
